"""Print names with one leading ``tmp_`` prefix removed."""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from remove_prefix import remove_prefix


names_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data" / "names.txt"

with names_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as names_file:
    for line in names_file:
        print(remove_prefix(line.rstrip("\n"), "tmp_"))
